abba.threshold_arithmetic: exact decimal strings of reported Run medians; inclusive limits without epsilon
abba.interpretation: Predeclared engineering confirmation criteria for two independent Runs per role. The 20 within-Run samples are correlated timing observations and are not pooled into 40 independent experiments. No confidence interval, statistical significance, generalization beyond these Runs, or Store promotion follows from this report.

limitations: Device input-cache immutability: not independently verifiable from retained artifacts; post-device input cache was not retained.
XPlane re-decoding validates retained event metadata and full duration/offset/step/run sample lineage, not the truth of the original hardware capture.
Full bundle hashes and loaded module paths validate identity, not that every bundled file executed.
Existing fixed correctness cases only; no LSE or wider workload coverage.
Two ABBA Runs per role offer limited replication; within-Run samples are not independent Runs.
Parent comparisons use exact same Context Evaluation; no cross-Runtime speedup ranking.
